{{Infobox faction | name = Wardens of Time | image = | faction = Neutral | leader = {{RaceIcon|DragonBronze}} [[Vairozdormu]] | races = {{RaceIcon|DragonBronze}} [[Bronze dragon]] | base = [[Caverns of Time]] | affiliation = [[Bronze dragonflight]] | status = Active | quartermaster={{RaceIcon|SpawnBronze|Male}} [[Dronormu]] | tabard = Wardens of Time Tabard.jpg }} The '''Wardens of Time''' are a group of the [[Bronze dragonflight]] that accepts the aid of any mortal that has earned access to the [[Caverns of Time]]. Their goal is to undo the mysterious time anomalies that have recently begun to appear across the timeways. ==Reputation== At honored, mobs in [[Caverns of Time: Black Morass]] will no longer grant reputation.
